newsitem.title: USA: Bank of NY buys corporate trust busines.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NY buys corporate trust busines.

text.p: Bank of New York Co said Tuesday that it had signed a definitive agreement to buy the corporate trust business of the former Boatmen's Bancshares from NationsBank Corp.
The bank said the transaction is expected to be completed during the third quarter of this year and will add to earnings immediately.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The deal involves the transfer to the Bank of New York of about 4,500 bond trustee and agency relationships for corporations and municipalities located throughout the central United States, the bank said.
It said that the deal represents the fifteenth corporate trust acquisition it has made in the past four years, including the acquisition of NationsBank's corporate trust business in 1995.
NationsBank completed its acquisition of Boatmen's Bancshares in January 1997.
